patch_list: Syncs the reading history with the iTruyenChu account without pressing the sync button: free chapters 1-50, which the server never sees, are recorded too, and the progress from other devices is merged in (with book titles) when the app sta…

Keeps reading with the screen off: React Native pauses JS timers when the app goes to the background, which stops the app from starting the next chapter. JS timers keep running while a reading session is active.
Fixes "Đăng nhập với Google" failing with error 400: the server now expects the Firebase ID token (like the website) instead of the email sent by this app version.

Opening a book from the bookshelf or "Đọc truyện" goes back to the line where the listening stopped: the voice bar opens with the play button and the line is highlighted, pressing play continues from there.

Shows the real chapter titles instead of "Vô Đề Mục" in the chapter list, the reader and the TTS: books whose chapter list only has "Chương N" get the title from the first line of the chapter text (public preview, no login needed), cached…

The media widget / lock screen shows the TTS reading instead of the silent 6 s file of the voice bar: playing or paused, the position in the chapter (line x/y), and its play / pause buttons pause and resume the reading.

Fixes text-to-speech reading that stops after a phone call or does nothing when pressing play: re-creates the TTS engine when it dies, pauses during calls and resumes afterwards, retries failed lines, uses the correct Vietnamese voice, and…
